7 Exception Item Litigation Expenses
During the financial year 2020 and 2021 Indegene Inc a subsidiary of the Company was named in a class action lawsuit filed in the U S District Court of New Jersey alleging non compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act of 1991 TCPA by sending unsolicited fax advertisements without the recipients prior express invitation or permission

Plaintiff initiated this matter through the filing of its Class Action Complaint against Indegene Inc Indegene Encima Inc Indegene Wincere Inc and Indegene Healthcare LLC collectively Indegene or Defendants seeking the Court to award actual monetary loss from the alleged TCPA violations in an amount to be proven in Court or the sum of USD 500 for each violation whichever is greater and that the Court award treble damages of USD 1500 if the violations are deemed wilful or knowing Additionally the Plaintiff seeks the Court award prejudgment interest and costs to be determined upon presentation of suitable evidentiary support

During the year ended 31 March 2026 the matter progressed to mediation and the Group agreed in principle to a mediator proposed settlement framework under which the Defendants would make available a maximum settlement fund of approximately INR417 or USD 4 millions and 720 thousands calculated at USD 250 per eligible claim The settlement is structured as a claims made arrangement whereby the actual outflow is contingent upon valid claims submitted by eligible class members and unclaimed amounts if any revert to the Group in accordance with the settlement terms Accordingly the maximum settlement fund does not represent the expected cash outflow

Based on the status of the proceedings and the Groups assessment supported by external legal advice the Group concluded that a present obligation existed and that an outflow of economic resources was probable and can be reliably estimated Accordingly the Group recognised a provision of INR203 or USD 2 millions and 300 thousands including estimated legal costs representing its best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the obligation which has been disclosed as exceptional item in the results for the year ended 31 March 2026 During the period ended 30 September 2026 pursuant to the courts orders the class administrator has issued notices to class members on 10 September 2026 requesting to submit claim forms or opt out of the settlement wherein the Class members have until 09 December 2026 to submit the claims or opt out The Settlement payments are expected to become payable following the final fairness hearing and Court approval in accordance with the settlement terms The amount payable will depend on valid claims submitted and attorneys fees awarded by the Court to the Plaintiffs counsel The ultimate outflow will be subject to the claims process and final Court approval Accordingly the Group does not estimate any change in amount of provision as at 30 September 2026

4 Acquisition of Cake Kommunikations
On 10 November 2025 the Group had entered into a stock purchase agreement to acquire Cake Kommunikations Holdings GmbH an SPV created to hold 70 percent in Cake Kommunikations GmbH AT 100 percent in CAKE Kommunikations GmbH DE and 100 percent in CAKE Kommunikations AG Switzerland and 30 percent in Cake Kommunikations GmbH AT from Werner Hinterberger Collectively Cake Group for an aggregate purchase consideration of INR 873 or EUR 8 millions 90 thousand including deferred and contingent consideration

Further on 30 January 2026 the Group had obtained control of Cake Group The Cake Group is an advertising agency specialized in healthcare and pharmaceutical communication The acquisition was consummated at a consideration of INR 873 which includes earnout component of INR 383 or EUR 3 millions and 550 thousands and an unconditional management incentive of INR 15 or EUR 140 thousand The earnout component is based on the performance of Cake during the period commencing on 1 April 2025 till 31 March 2028 with the range of earnout from Nil to INR 470 or EUR 4 millions and 350 thousands while the unconditional management incentive of INR 15 or EUR 140 thousand falls due on 1 June 2028

The Group believes that the acquisition will enable the Group to expand its healthcare marketing and communication capabilities in Europe specifically targeting the DACH region Germany Austria and Switzerland thereby strengthening the Groups footprint by offering specialized hightouch marketing services The Group concluded that the acquired set was a business and did the provisional PPA during the year ended 31 March 2026 The same has been finalised during the period ended 30 September 2026

6 Segment information
During the year ended 31 March 2026 the Group effective 01 October 2025 has reorganised its segments by merging Brand Activation Segment as part of Enterprise Commercial Solutions in line with the manner in which the chief operating decision maker reviews and evaluates performance of the business of the Group Pursuant to the above in accordance with the requirement specified in Ind AS 108 the comparative period information has been recasted to give the effect of this change
As a consequence the Group currently has 2 reportable segment i e Enterprise Commercial Solutions and Enterprise Medical Solutions

Operating segments are identified as components of an enterprise for which discrete financials information is evaluated regularly by the chief operating decision maker in deciding how to allocate resources and assessing performance The Groups chief operating decision maker is the Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director

Assets and liabilities used in the Groups business are not identified to any of the operating segments as these are used interchangeably between segments Management believes that it is currently not practicable to provide segment disclosures relating to total assets and liabilities since a meaningful segregation of the available data is onerous
